defi.title: xStocks Vaults: the leverage loop behind the yield
defi.summary: The client holds a vault share on Ink; the xStock itself is bridged to Solana and becomes Kamino collateral.

steps.label: Kraken sends the client's xStock to an embedded wallet on Ink and wraps it into the vault
Sentora bridges the xStock to Solana with Chainlink CCIP
A strategist key moves the xStock to the strategy program (manage)
The xStock is posted as collateral in the curated Kamino market
PYUSD is borrowed against it at a variable rate
Borrowed PYUSD is deposited into a Kamino Earn vault
That Earn vault lends PYUSD on to Kamino reserves — including this same market
Rewards are swapped back into the xStock (swap route not decoded)

defi.note: If the stock falls far enough, Kamino liquidators can seize the xStock; the loss is shared by vault users. Kraken states withdrawals take up to 3 days.

defi.title: SECZ on Loopscale: a liquidation that waits for the issuer
defi.summary: New SECZ accounts are born frozen, so seized collateral can go nowhere until Securitize thaws a receiver.

steps.label: Securitize creates and thaws the loan’s collateral account (registering the wallet)
Loan crosses its 40% liquidation LTV; Loopscale triggers liquidation
The liquidation engine holds no SECZ account — and any new one is created frozen
Securitize must thaw a receiving account first — an off-chain onboarding decision with no stated timing
Only then can the seized SECZ move to the liquidator, lender vault or buyer

defi.note: Securitize keeps the freeze authority, so it could also freeze the loan's own collateral account. No SECZ liquidation has been observed.
